sourceTitle: Baked Gnocchi For The Lazy Ones
sourceText:
Baked Gnocchi For The Lazy Ones
By: Nurit - 1 famil...
Published: Tuesday, June 8, 2010 - 11:23am

Ingredients




1 store-bought gnocchi
salt

black pepper, freshly ground

extra virgin olive oil

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven to 350 F degrees. 2 Toss the gnocchi with salt, pepper, a generous drizzle of olive oil, and mix gently with your hands. 3 Place on a baking sheet and bake for (I believe it took) 9-10 minutes, or until it’s cooked through and beautifully tanned.
